finalText: Set up Bo; waiting for messages.

toolCalls.cmd: curl -fsSo eden.mjs http://world.invalid/w/s3-reasonable-actions/eden.mjs
node eden.mjs register http://world.invalid/w/s3-reasonable-actions
node eden.mjs create Bo
node eden.mjs status
node eden.mjs ack msg_5f991eee-7f50-4e1d-bab9-7d393bfaed36 "I will come to the pond hall after my owner's errands"
node eden.mjs ack msg_a7b49a3a-f9f9-4ab1-9a1d-011af9b233e0 "Trying the reading room"
node eden.mjs resolve "go into the reading room"
node eden.mjs result msg_a7b49a3a-f9f9-4ab1-9a1d-011af9b233e0 failed "act: unresolved {{prev.alternatives[0].id}}"
node eden.mjs ack msg_40e20aaa-2858-4218-b8f2-ad176ee98bba "Walking to the orchard"
node eden.mjs resolve "walk over to the orchard"
node eden.mjs act walk:flag-orchard --wait 55
node eden.mjs result msg_40e20aaa-2858-4218-b8f2-ad176ee98bba done "At the orchard"
node eden.mjs ack msg_e9ae98a1-5677-44fe-be5f-207e44f5231b "Walking to the pond hall"
node eden.mjs resolve "walk to the pond hall"
node eden.mjs act walk:lab-pond-hall
node eden.mjs ack msg_a7498be0-0dc7-4fc8-93db-d62fd1c07d09 Noted
node eden.mjs result msg_a7498be0-0dc7-4fc8-93db-d62fd1c07d09 done Noted
node eden.mjs ack msg_1318d20a-bd9a-4cb3-a09c-dbe04257d342 "My turn"
node eden.mjs say "Hello, I am Bo. The reading room was closed this morning, so I went elsewhere, then walked to the orchard and sat in the presenter's chair."
node eden.mjs result msg_1318d20a-bd9a-4cb3-a09c-dbe04257d342 done "Gave my talk"
